subject: general
question: Which national park in India has the maximum number of rhinos?
solution:
The correct answer is** __Kaziranga National Park.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **​​Rhinos **are a member of any of the five extant species of odd-toed ungulates in the family** Rhinocerotidae.**
 
• **Kaziranga National Park **is a protected area in the northeast** Indian state of Assam.**
 
• **Kaziranga **is regarded as one of the finest **wildlife refuges in the world.**​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **​​Keibul Lamjao National Park** is a national park in the Bishnupur district of the state of Manipur in India.
 
• **Kanha National Park **has a significant population of the Royal Bengal tiger, Indian leopards, the sloth bear, barasingha and Indian wild dog.
 
• **Nagarhole National Park** is a wildlife reserve in the South Indian state of Karnataka.
